top_signals.title: Gold Set for Worst Week Since March on Hawkish Fed, AI Selloff
top_signals.summary: Gold fell for a fifth day — heading for the biggest weekly decline since March — as a hawkish Federal Reserve signaled more interest-rate hikes and a rout in AI stocks spurred selling across metals markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
